# How to Merge Audio with Claude MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Claude MCP and Medux to concatenate multiple audio files into one, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_merge_audio`

## Prompt

```text
Concatenate multiple audio files into one.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_ids` (required): Input audio file id list.
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: merge-audio-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
